# FLX-7013: the observation is dated before the horizon of the forecast

**Family:** calibration (the 7000 band)

A forecast is sealed with the horizon_end it was made for, the instant after which the next state can be read. `fluxsim forecast score --observed-at` dates the observation, and one dated before that instant was read before the outcome could be known, so it is refused and nothing is scored or written. An observation dated exactly at the horizon end is accepted. Pass the instant the next state was read, or score once the horizon has passed.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-7013
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
